full_name: Erica Chenoweth | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Social Sciences Susan S. and Kenneth L. Wallach Professor Harvard Kennedy School
bio: Erica Chenoweth is a Susan S. and Kenneth L. Wallach Professor at Harvard Radcliffe Institute and the Frank Stanton Professor of the First Amendment at Harvard Kennedy School. Chenoweth is on the core faculty at Harvard’s Carr Center for Human Rights Policy, where they direct the Nonviolent Action Lab.
